Methods for measuring food consumption at the national level
Food balance sheets
The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) publishes food balance sheets (FBSs) for approximately 200 countries. FBSs present
a comprehensive picture of the pattern of a country’s food supply during a speciﬁed reference period. Food balance sheets may also
